name: mkpelletier/moodle-local_unifiedgrader
description: Unified Grader for Moodle — a single grading interface across assignments, forums, quizzes and BigBlueButton sessions.

scripts-descriptions.cs: Run the Moodle coding standard over the plugin (same ruleset as CI's Code Checker).
scripts-descriptions.cs-fix: Apply the automatically fixable coding-standard corrections.
scripts-descriptions.cs-summary: One line per file with findings, instead of the full report.
